en.name: BMR Calculator

en.metaTitle: BMR Calculator - Free Basal Metabolic Rate & TDEE Tool
en.metaDescription: Calculate your Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) and Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) with the Mifflin-St Jeor formula.
en.description: Calculate the minimum calories your body burns at rest to maintain essential vital functions.
en.shortDescription: Calculate the minimum calories your body burns at rest to maintain essential vital functions.
en.intro: Calculate the minimum calories your body burns at rest to maintain essential vital functions.
en.formulaDescription: Widely considered the gold standard equation to estimate basal resting metabolic calories.
en.formulaEquation: Mifflin-St Jeor: BMR = (10 × weight_kg) + (6.25 × height_cm) - (5 × age) + s (s=+5 men, -161 women)
stepByStep: Select gender and enter age, height, and body weight.
Choose your physical activity level to compute daily maintenance calories (TDEE).
Review your baseline BMR and caloric requirements for weight loss or muscle gain.

workedExample.title: BMR Calculation Example
workedExample.scenario: A 28-year-old male, 175 cm tall, weighing 70 kg.

faqs.question: What is Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR)?
faqs.answer: BMR is the baseline energy expenditure required to sustain breathing, circulation, and organ function at complete rest.

faqs.question: How is BMR different from TDEE?
faqs.answer: TDEE multiplies BMR by an activity factor to include exercise, digestion, and daily movement.

en.notes: Widely considered the gold standard equation to estimate basal resting metabolic calories.

faqs.question: 基礎代謝（BMR）とは何ですか？
faqs.answer: 呼吸や心臓の拍動、体温維持など、生きているだけで消費される最低限のエネルギーです。

faqs.question: ダイエットで基礎代謝を下回る食事は危険ですか？
faqs.answer: はい、筋肉減少や代謝低下を招くため、基礎代謝量以上のカロリー摂取が推奨されます。

ja.notes: 性別、体重、身長、年齢から最も正確に基礎代謝量を算出できるとされる国際標準の計算式です。

faqs.question: Qu’est-ce que le métabolisme de base ?
faqs.answer: L’énergie indispensable au fonctionnement du cœur, des poumons et des cellules au repos.

faqs.question: Comment augmenter son métabolisme de base ?
faqs.answer: En augmentant sa masse musculaire grâce à la musculation et un apport protéiné adéquat.

faqs.question: Was bedeutet Grundumsatz (BMR)?
faqs.answer: Die Energiemenge, die bei völliger Ruhe zur Aufrechterhaltung der Organfunktionen benötigt wird.

faqs.question: Sollte man unter dem Grundumsatz essen?
faqs.answer: Nein, eine dauerhafte Kalorienzufuhr unter dem BMR kann den Stoffwechsel verlangsamen.
